programs.title: CFP Semifinal at the VRBO Fiesta Bowl
programs.desc: No. 6 Ole Miss faces No. 10 Miami in the Fiesta Bowl at State Farm Stadium for a spot in the College Football Playoff semifinals. The Rebels seek an eighth straight win behind Kewan Lacy (23 TDs), while the Hurricanes lean on QB Carson Beck (27 TDs).

programs.title: CFP Quarterfinal at the Goodyear Cotton Bowl Classic
programs.desc: The No. 10 Miami Hurricanes face the No. 2 Ohio State Buckeyes at AT&T Stadium. This is a high-stakes College Football Playoff Quarterfinal matchup. Miami advanced after a gritty 10-3 road upset over No. 7 Texas A&M in the CFP First Round.

programs.title: College Football
programs.desc: The No. 7 Aggies host the No. 10 Hurricanes in the College Football Playoff's first round. Texas A&M saw its undefeated season, and its chance at the SEC title, spoiled in a Nov. 28 loss at Texas. These programs traded home wins in 2022 and 2023.
